gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare commencing at the northern end of Tai Yip Street, running in a north-westerly direction for a distance of about 435 m and terminating in front of the proposed Mass Transit Railway Depot. Shown coloured pink on drawing No. KH 1731/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 起點在大業街北端，向西北伸展約四百三十五公尺，終點在擬建地下鐵路車站前面。（在KH1731/1號圖則上用粉紅色標明）

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Thoroughfare about 120 m long commencing at its junction with Tai Yip Street and running on the south side of Ngau Tau Kok Police Station. Shown coloured green on drawing No. KH 1731/1.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 全長約一百二十公尺，起點與上述大業街會合，沿牛頭角警署南邊伸展。（在KH1731/1號圖則上用綠色標明）
